items.question: Under UAE law, is collecting donations at mosques without permission from the competent authorities prohibited?
items.gold: Yes, Article 8 of Federal Law No. 4 for 2018 prohibits collecting donations at mosques without permission.
items.fact: Article 8 bans mosque donation collection without authority permission

items.question: Under UAE fundraising regulation, are natural persons allowed to host, organise or carry out fund-raising activities?
items.gold: No, natural persons are not allowed to host, organise or carry out fund-raising activities.
items.fact: Natural persons barred from hosting or organising fundraising activities
